subtopic: Newton's Third Law and Conservation of Momentum
stem:
Three identical bodies each of mass m, are pushed by a force F on a frictionless table as shown in figure.

(The figure shows three identical blocks of mass m each — labelled X, Y and Z from left to right — placed in contact in a row on a frictionless table. A horizontal force F is applied from the left on block X, pushing the whole row to the right.)

Which of the following options is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Net force on X is F.

options.label: B
options.text: Net force on Y is equal to zero.

options.label: C
options.text: Force applied by Y on Z is equal to net force on X.

options.label: D
options.text: Force applied by X on Y is \(\frac{F}{3}\).

subtopic: Newton's Third Law and Conservation of Momentum
stem:
Consider two spring balances hooked as shown in the figure. We pull them in opposite directions. If the reading shown by A is 1.5 N, the reading shown by B will be

(The figure shows two spring balances A and B connected in series, hooked end to end horizontally; a hand pulls balance A to the left and another hand pulls balance B to the right with equal and opposite forces.)

Which of the following is the velocity - time graph of a moving particle on which net force is zero?

The four options are velocity (y-axis) versus time (x-axis) graphs:
A) a graph that is zero except for a single instantaneous vertical spike, i.e. an irregular, discontinuous line.
B) a straight line rising with a constant positive slope from the origin (velocity increasing uniformly with time).
C) a straight line falling with a constant negative slope down to zero (velocity decreasing uniformly with time).
D) a horizontal straight line at a constant non-zero velocity (velocity unchanging with time).

options.label: A
options.text: Graph A (an instantaneous vertical spike, otherwise zero)

options.label: B
options.text: Graph B (a straight line of constant positive slope — velocity increasing)

options.label: C
options.text: Graph C (a straight line of constant negative slope — velocity decreasing)

options.label: D
options.text: Graph D (a horizontal line at constant velocity)
